explanation: Italian business culture values relationships and flexibility, so being a few minutes late to a meeting is generally tolerated and not seen as a serious breach, especially once rapport is established. That said, punctuality is still respected, particularly in northern business centers, and habitual lateness without notice can hurt your credibility.
local_tip: Aim to arrive on time, but don't panic over a short, unannounced delay — a brief apology on arrival is usually enough.
regional_note: Flexibility around time tends to be more pronounced in the south than in business-focused northern cities like Milan.

also_check.note: Punctuality is a strict cultural norm; even a few minutes late is seen as disrespectful.
Arriving late is a serious breach of etiquette; being early is expected.
A 15-30 minute delay is common and often expected in business meetings.

sources.title: Business Culture Around the World: Italy
